title: Received proposal
question: Question
exclusionsTitle: What this analysis does not do
units: Amounts in millions of {currency}; spreads and costs in percent a year over CDI; covenant in times EBITDA.
noReading: Premises are missing to read the proposal; what is missing is in the gaps.

openQuestions.indexer_confirmation: Before any number, the proposal's indexer must be confirmed by the term sheet or by the company.

firmness.indicative: Indicative proposal, subject to credit approval, valid until {date}.

sawIndenture: The bank has seen the indenture.
didNotSeeIndenture: The bank has not seen the indenture.
diligence: In diligence, the indenture's lien restriction is likely to surface, and credit is likely to reopen the structure.
liquidity: In {year}, existing debt service is {existing} against {available} of cash available to meet it; the proposal adds {proposal}, for a total of {total}.
peakQuarter: The heaviest pressure falls in the quarter ending {date}.
minimumWith: With the proposal, the lowest cash in the horizon is {amount}, on {date}.
belowPolicy: With the proposal, cash falls below the minimum from {with}; without it, from {without}.
belowPolicyWithOnly: With the proposal, cash falls below the minimum from {with}.
fitTitle: Term against the use of the money
fit: {share} of the amount funds a seasonal use. Average life of {life} years, last payment on {date}.

useReadings.longer_than_use: the proposal's term exceeds the term of the use
useReadings.shorter_than_use: the proposal's term is shorter than the term of the use
useReadings.within_use: the proposal's term fits the term of the use

testsPerYear: The lender tests {lender} times a year; the indenture, {indenture}.
anyBreachUnknown: Without every required test, there is no compliance conclusion.
anyBreachYes: There is a date and case where a limit goes above what is allowed with the proposal.
anyBreachNo: On every required date and case, the limits stay within what is allowed with the proposal.
untestedLimits: Limits with no test at all, not tested: {list}.
lenderBeforeDraw: Lender test dates before the draw, as contrast only: {list}.
collateral: Coverage of {coverage}% asks for {required} of receivables. Of the {free} nominally free, {assignable} can be assigned.
shortfall: The assignable portfolio is {shortfall} short of the request.
leftAfter: After the assignment, {left} remains assignable, against a seasonal peak of {peak}.
restrictedAccount: The bank asks for a restricted account.
atTop: The requested coverage is at or above the top of the reference.

reasons.assignment_prohibited_without_debtor_con: contract forbids assignment without the debtor's consent

pledge: The indenture's basket for new liens is {limit} ({basis}), with {occupied} already used; {remaining} remains.
consent: The requested collateral exceeds the basket by {excess} and depends on the debenture holders' consent.
consentWindow: Calling the meeting now, consent comes by {by}; the money is needed on {need} ({slack} days of slack).
noConsent: The requested collateral fits in the indenture's basket.
price: Nominal spread of CDI plus {nominal}. Effective cost over the life of CDI plus {gross} gross.
net: Net of tax, CDI plus {net}, under the simplified full-deduction convention in lucro real.

netConventions.not_all_periods_taxable: There is a period without taxable profit in the proposal's life; the net cost is not stated.
netConventions.life_beyond_fiscal_calendar: The proposal runs beyond the adopted fiscal calendar; without a hypothesis for those years, the net cost is not stated.
netConventions.no_deduction_presumido: Under lucro presumido, the net cost equals the gross cost.
netConventions.regime_unknown: Tax regime not reported; net cost not computed.

upfront: Fee and IOF withheld at the draw add up to {upfront}% of the amount, of which {iof}% is IOF.

positions.at_or_below_median: within the range, up to the median
positions.above_median_within_range: within the range, above the median

market: The nominal spread is {position} of comparables, from {low}% to {high}% with a median of {median}% ({sample} comparables, {confidence} confidence, on {date}).
history: Against the {peer} ({date}): observed difference of {observed} basis points, expected {expected}, residual {residual}.
historyNoResidual: Against the {peer} ({date}): observed difference of {observed} basis points, expected {expected}.
asksTitle: What each ask to the bank buys
alternativesTitle: The company's alternatives on the same basis
questionsTitle: Questions for the bank and the company

facts.proposal_indicative: The proposal is indicative and depends on credit approval.
facts.collateral_exceeds_assignable_portfolio: The requested collateral exceeds the portfolio that can be assigned.
facts.assignment_prohibited_receivables_exclud: Receivables of a customer that forbids assignment are left out.
facts.indenture_consent_required: The requested collateral exceeds the indenture's basket and depends on the debenture holders' consent.
facts.peak_year_service_exceeds_available_cash: In the peak year, debt service exceeds the cash available to meet it.
facts.cash_below_minimum_with_proposal: With the proposal, cash falls below the minimum in some quarter.
facts.board_policy_breached_in_a_case: In some case, leverage exceeds the board policy limit.
facts.lender_tests_more_often_than_indenture: The lender tests the covenant more often than the indenture.
facts.restricted_account_requested: The bank asks for a restricted account.
facts.coverage_at_top_of_reference: The requested coverage is at or above the top of the reference.

readings.term_longer_than_seasonal_use: The term is longer than the seasonal use it funds.
readings.term_shorter_than_capex_use: The term is shorter than the life of the investment it funds.
readings.all_in_cost_well_above_nominal: The cost over the life is well above the nominal spread.
readings.nominal_spread_below_range: The nominal spread is below the comparables range.
readings.nominal_spread_at_or_below_median: The nominal spread is within the range, up to the median.
readings.nominal_spread_above_median_within_range: The nominal spread is within the range, above the median.
readings.nominal_spread_above_range: The nominal spread is above the comparables range.
readings.improvement_partly_paid_in_collateral: The improvement against the last operation is partly paid with collateral.
readings.real_improvement_against_last_operation: The improvement against the last operation remains after the adjustments.
readings.covenant_headroom_tight: Covenant headroom is tight on some date.
readings.net_cost_conditioned_on_taxable_profit: The net cost depends on taxable profit not adopted for the whole life.

recommendations.address_indenture_consent_before_signing: Address the indenture consent with the bank before signing.
recommendations.ask_longer_grace_and_tenor: Ask for longer grace and tenor to relieve the peak year.
recommendations.ask_lower_coverage_and_no_restricted_acc: Ask for lower coverage and no restricted account.
recommendations.separate_uses_by_term: Separate the uses by term, with a route for each.
recommendations.keep_price_discussion_secondary: With the spread in the range, negotiate the structure before the price.

wouldChange.debtor_consent_for_restricted_receivable: Consent from the customer that forbids assignment.
wouldChange.indenture_clause_wording: The wording of the indenture's lien clause.
wouldChange.other_free_asset_for_collateral: Another free asset to make up the collateral.
wouldChange.seasonal_need_above_adopted: A seasonal need above the one adopted.

questions.lender_covenant_definition: To the bank: is the covenant definition the indenture's?
questions.reciprocity_expected_by_lender: To the bank: is reciprocity expected?
questions.restricted_debtor_consent: To the company: would the customer that forbids assignment consent?
questions.indenture_clause_wording: To the company: is the indenture's basket an aggregate amount or per operation, and what is already in it?
questions.other_free_asset: To the company: is there another free asset to make up the collateral?

process: This analysis does not accept the proposal, does not talk to the bank and does not send a counterproposal.
